name: Hill chicken
summary: Native chicken that runs the hills, with firm meat. It comes grilled over charcoal without a smoky taste, or steamed with lime leaf, with chẩm chéo for dipping.
origin: The homestay table of the Mai Châu valley.
taste: Grilled over charcoal, it carries no smoky taste.
howToEat: As a shared plate at the homestay.
where: Valley homestays in Bản Lác and Pom Coọng.
seoTitle: Ga doi in Mai Chau — hill chicken at the homestay
seoDescription: Gà đồi is native hill chicken with firm meat, grilled over charcoal or steamed with lime leaf. Eat it with chẩm chéo at the homestay.
